headline: A. Tsipras: 'We will tax wealth, not businesspeople and the middle class' – What he said about the Pierrakakis law
summary: Former Greek prime minister Alexis Tsipras said his party would tax wealth rather than businesspeople and the middle class. He accused the Mitsotakis government of distributing the tax burden disproportionately under the Pierrakakis law.
why: Tax policy shapes corporate profitability, household disposable income and the investment climate in Greece.
